name: split_density_to_rows
statement:
theorem split_density_to_rows {n : ℕ} (M : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) :
    density M = ∑ i, row_density M i
proof:
:= by
  simpa [density, row_density, card_eq_sum_ones, -sum_const] using
    Finset.sum_finset_product _ _ _ (by simp)

name: density_by_rows_ub
statement:
theorem density_by_rows_ub {n c : ℕ} (M : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (h_row_density_bounded : ∀ i, row_density M i ≤ c) : density M ≤ n * c
proof:
:= calc
    density M
  _ = ∑ i, row_density M i := split_density_to_rows M
  _ ≤ ∑ _, c := by gcongr; exact h_row_density_bounded _
  _ = n * c := by simp

name: split_density_to_cols
statement:
theorem split_density_to_cols {n : ℕ} (M : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) :
    density M = ∑ i, col_density M i

name: density_by_cols_ub
statement:
theorem density_by_cols_ub {n c : ℕ} (M : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (h_col_bounded : ∀ i, col_density M i ≤ c) : density M ≤ n * c
proof:
:= calc
      density M
  _ = ∑ i, col_density M i := split_density_to_cols M
  _ ≤ ∑ _, c := by gcongr; exact h_col_bounded _
  _ = n * c := by simp

name: card_interval
statement:
lemma card_interval {n : ℕ} (x y : ℕ) (hy : y ≤ n) :
    #{a : Fin n | ↑a ∈ Finset.Ico x y} = #(.Ico x y)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun (a : Fin n) _ ↦ ↑a) (by aesop) (by aesop) ?_
  intro b hb
  simp at hb
  exact ⟨⟨b, by omega⟩, by simpa⟩

name: card_rectPtSet
statement:
@[simp] lemma card_rectPtSet (n a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℕ) (h : b₁ ≤ n ∧ b₂ ≤ n) :
    #(rectPtset n a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂) = (b₁ - a₁) * (b₂ - a₂)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rectPtset, card_product]
  suffices claim : ∀ x y, y ≤ n → #{a : Fin n | ↑a ∈ Finset.Ico x y} = #(.Ico x y) by aesop
  intro x y hy
  exact card_interval x y hy

statement:
theorem den_all1_matrix_column_interval {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n) :
    let I
proof:
:= ({x | ↑x ∈ Finset.Icc a.1 b.1} : Finset (Fin n))
    let M (i j : Fin n) : Prop := (i, j) ∈ Finset.univ ×ˢ I

  have h1 : #I = #(.Icc a.1 b.1) := by

    have e : Finset.Ico a.1 (b.1 + 1) = Finset.Icc a.1 b.1 := by
      ext x; simp
    rw [e] at this
    simpa [I] using this
  have h2 : #(.Icc a.1 b.1) = b.1 +1 - a.1 := by simp
  calc
    density M = n * #I := den_all1_matrix_col_subset I
    _ = n * #(.Icc a.1 b.1) := by rw [h1]

section Prelude1
variable {α β γ δ : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [LinearOrder β] [LinearOrder γ] [LinearOrder δ]
  {P : α → β → Prop} {M : γ → δ → Prop}

def Contains (P : α → β → Prop) (M : γ → δ → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : α → γ, StrictMono f ∧ ∃ g : β → δ, StrictMono g ∧ ∀ a b, P a b → M (f a) (g b)

instance {P : α → β → Prop} {M : γ → δ → Prop} [DecidableRel P] [DecidableRel M]
    [DecidableLT α] [DecidableLT β] [DecidableLT γ] [DecidableLT δ]
    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ] [Fintype δ] : Decidable (Contains P M) :=
  inferInstanceAs <| Decidable <|
    ∃ f : α → γ, StrictMono f ∧ ∃ g : β → δ, StrictMono g ∧ ∀ a b, P a b → M (f a) (g b)

@[refl]
lemma contains_refl (M : γ → δ → Prop) : Contains M M :=
  ⟨id, by simp [StrictMono], id, by simp [StrictMono], by aesop⟩

lemma contains_rfl {M : γ → δ → Prop} : Contains M M := by rfl

@[simp] lemma contains_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty α] [IsEmpty β] : Contains P M := by
   simp [Contains, StrictMono]

lemma not_contains_false (P : α → β → Prop) (P_nonempty : ∃ a b, P a b) :
    ¬ Contains P fun (_ : γ) (_ : δ) ↦ False := by simp [Contains, *]
end Prelude1

@[simp] lemma ex_zero (P : α → β → Prop) : ex P 0 = 0 := by simp [ex, density]

theorem le_ex_iff (P : α → β → Prop) (P_nonempty : ∃ a b, P a b) {m n : ℕ} :
    m ≤ ex P n ↔ ∃ (M : Fin n → Fin n → Prop), ¬ Contains P M ∧ m ≤ density M := by
  obtain rfl | hm := eq_zero_or_pos m
  · simpa using ⟨_, not_contains_false P P_nonempty⟩
  · simp [ex, Finset.le_sup_iff hm]

lemma density_row {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n) :
    density (fun (i _ : Fin n) => i = x) = n := by
  classical
  unfold density
  have : (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.1 = x) = {x} ×ˢ Finset.univ := by
    ext ⟨a, b⟩; simp [eq_comm]
  simp only [Prod.mk.eta]
  rw [this]; simp

lemma density_col {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n) :
    density (fun (_ j : Fin n) => j = x) = n := by
  classical
  unfold density
  have : (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.2 = x) = Finset.univ ×ˢ {x} := by
    ext ⟨a, b⟩; simp [eq_comm]
  simp only [Prod.mk.eta]
  rw [this]; simp

name: exists_av_and_ex_eq
statement:
lemma exists_av_and_ex_eq {n : ℕ} {P : α → β → Prop} (P_nonempty : ∃ a b, P a b) :

proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa [ex] using Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup {M : Fin n → Fin n → Prop | ¬ Contains P M}
    ⟨_, by simpa using not_contains_false P P_nonempty⟩ density

name: split_density
statement:
theorem split_density {n : ℕ} (M : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) (Pred : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) :
    let M1 (i j : Fin n) : Prop
proof:
:= M i j ∧  (Pred i j);
    let M2 (i j : Fin n) : Prop := M i j ∧ ¬ (Pred i j);
    density M = density M1 + density M2 := by
  classical
  let M1 (i j : Fin n) : Prop := M i j ∧  (Pred i j);
  let M2 (i j : Fin n) : Prop := M i j ∧ ¬ (Pred i j);
  let s1 : Finset (Fin n × Fin n) := {(i, j) | M1 i j}
  let s2 : Finset (Fin n × Fin n) := {(i, j) | M2 i j}
  let s : Finset (Fin n × Fin n) := {(i, j) | M  i j}
  have seqs1s2 : s = s1 ∪ s2 := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro xins
      simp [s] at xins
      simp [s1, s2, M1, M2]
      tauto
    · intro xins1s2
      simp [s1, s2, M1, M2] at xins1s2
      simp [s]
      tauto
  have dm : density M = s.card := by simp [density, s]
  have dm1 : density M1 = #s1 := by simp [density_def, s1]
  have dm2 : density M2 = #s2 := by simp [density_def, s2]
  have s1eqs2card : (s1 ∪ s2).card = s1.card + s2.card := by
    apply card_union_of_disjoint
    rw [disjoint_left]
    aesop
  rw [← seqs1s2] at s1eqs2card
  aesop

name: ex_horizontal
statement: theorem ex_horizontal (k n : ℕ) : ex (HorizontalPattern k) n ≤ n*(k-1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [ex, Finset.sup_le_iff, mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  intro M NoHPk
  refine density_by_rows_ub M fun i ↦ ?_
  contrapose! NoHPk
  simp [row_density] at NoHPk
  let s : Finset (Fin n) := {j | M i j}
  have h : k ≤ s.card := by simp [s]; omega
  let g := s.orderEmbOfCardLe h
  simp only [Contains, Fin.forall_fin_one, Fin.isValue]
  refine ⟨![i], by simp [StrictMono], g, by simp [StrictMono, OrderEmbedding.lt_iff_lt], ?_⟩
  simp only [Fin.isValue, AllPattern, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, forall_const]
  intro j
  simpa [s] using s.orderEmbOfCardLe_mem h j
end

name: ex_vertical
statement: theorem ex_vertical (k n : ℕ) : ex (VerticalPattern k) n ≤ n*(k-1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    ex (VerticalPattern k) n
    _ ≤ ex ( tranpose (VerticalPattern k)) n := ?exv
    _ = ex ( HorizontalPattern k) n := by rfl
    _ ≤ n*(k-1) := ex_horizontal k n
  case exv =>
    simp only [ex, Finset.sup_le_iff, mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    intro M hM
    rw [← ex]
    let M' := tranpose M
    have hM' : ¬ Contains (tranpose (VerticalPattern k)) M' := by
      by_contra H
      obtain ⟨f, hf, g, hg, emb_pat_to_M'⟩ := H
      have : Contains (VerticalPattern k) M := by
        refine ⟨g, hg, f, hf, by
          intro a b
          apply emb_pat_to_M'
        ⟩
      contradiction
    have dmeqdm' : density M = density M' :=
      Finset.card_equiv (Equiv.prodComm ..) fun _ ↦ by simp; rfl
    calc
      density M = density M' := dmeqdm'
      _        ≤ ex (tranpose (VerticalPattern k)) n := (density_le_ex_of_not_contains M' hM')

variable {α β γ δ : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [LinearOrder β] [LinearOrder γ] [LinearOrder δ] {m n : ℕ}

open scoped Classical in
noncomputable def density (M : Fin m → Fin n → Prop) : ℕ := #{(i, j) : Fin m × Fin n | M i j}

@[gcongr] lemma density_mono {M N : Fin m → Fin n → Prop} (h : ∀ i j, M i j → N i j) :

    (h_row_density_bounded : ∀ i, row_density M i ≤ c) : density M ≤ n * c := calc
    density M
  _ = ∑ i, row_density M i := split_density_to_rows M
  _ ≤ ∑ _, c := by gcongr; exact h_row_density_bounded _

  classical
  simp only [ex, Finset.sup_le_iff, mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  intro M NoHPk
  refine density_by_rows_ub M fun i ↦ ?_
  contrapose! NoHPk
  simp [row_density] at NoHPk
  let s : Finset (Fin n) := {j | M i j}
  have h : k ≤ s.card := by simp [s]; omega
  let g := s.orderEmbOfCardLe h
  simp only [Contains, Fin.forall_fin_one, Fin.isValue]
  refine ⟨![i], by simp [StrictMono], g, by simp [StrictMono, OrderEmbedding.lt_iff_lt], ?_⟩

name: ex_hat
statement: theorem ex_hat (n : ℕ) : ex HatPattern n ≤ 3 * n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [ex, Finset.sup_le_iff, mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  intro M noHat
  let min_or_max_of_row := fun i j ↦ (∀ j', M i j' → j ≤ j') ∨ (∀ j', M i j' → j' ≤ j)
  let M1 (i j : Fin n) : Prop := M i j ∧ (min_or_max_of_row i j)
  let M2 (i j : Fin n) : Prop := M i j ∧ ¬ (min_or_max_of_row i j)
  have M1_avoids_H3 : ¬ Contains (HorizontalPattern 3) M1 := by
    rintro ⟨f, _, g, g_mono, prop⟩
    simp only [AllPattern, forall_const, Fin.forall_fin_one, Fin.isValue] at prop
    simp only [Fin.isValue, M1] at prop
    obtain ⟨_, h_min_max_g1⟩ : M (f 0) (g 1) ∧ min_or_max_of_row (f 0) (g 1) := prop 1
    cases h_min_max_g1 with
     | inl g1_min =>
      have : g 1 ≤ g 0 := by aesop (add simp g1_min)
      have : g 0 < g 1 := by aesop (add simp g_mono)
      omega
     | inr g1_max =>
      have : g 2 ≤ g 1 := by aesop (add simp g1_max)
      have : g 1 < g 2 := by aesop (add simp g_mono)
      omega
  have M2_avoids_V2 : ¬ Contains (VerticalPattern 2) M2 := by
    rintro ⟨f, hf, g, _, v2_to_M2⟩
    simp only [AllPattern, not_or, not_forall, not_le, forall_const, Fin.forall_fin_one,
      Fin.isValue, Fin.forall_fin_two, M2, min_or_max_of_row] at v2_to_M2
    obtain ⟨⟨hib, -, -⟩, -, ⟨a, hja, hab⟩, c, hjc, hbc⟩ := v2_to_M2
    set b := g 0
    exact noHat ⟨f, hf, ![a, b, c], by simp [StrictMono, Fin.forall_fin_succ, *, hab.trans hbc], by
      simp [HatPattern, Fin.forall_fin_succ, *]⟩
  have dm1 := calc
        density M1
    _ ≤ ex (HorizontalPattern 3) n := density_le_ex_of_not_contains M1 M1_avoids_H3
    _ ≤ n * 2 := ex_horizontal 3 n
  have dm2 := calc
        density M2
    _ ≤ ex (VerticalPattern 2) n := density_le_ex_of_not_contains M2 M2_avoids_V2
    _ = n := ex_verticalPattern_two n
  calc
        density M
    _ = density M1 + density M2 := split_density M min_or_max_of_row
    _ ≤ n * 2 + density M2 := by simp [dm1]
    _ ≤ n * 2 + n := by simp [dm2]
    _ ≤ 3 * n := by omega
end P3

    (h_row_density_bounded : ∀ i, row_density M i ≤ c) : density M ≤ n * c := calc

  _ = ∑ i, row_density M i := split_density_to_rows M
  _ ≤ ∑ _, c := by gcongr; exact h_row_density_bounded _

theorem split_density {n : ℕ} (M : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) (Pred : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) :
    let M1 (i j : Fin n) : Prop := M i j ∧  (Pred i j);
    let M2 (i j : Fin n) : Prop := M i j ∧ ¬ (Pred i j);
    density M = density M1 + density M2 := by
  classical
  let M1 (i j : Fin n) : Prop := M i j ∧  (Pred i j);
  let M2 (i j : Fin n) : Prop := M i j ∧ ¬ (Pred i j);
  let s1 : Finset (Fin n × Fin n) := {(i, j) | M1 i j}
  let s2 : Finset (Fin n × Fin n) := {(i, j) | M2 i j}
  let s : Finset (Fin n × Fin n) := {(i, j) | M  i j}
  have seqs1s2 : s = s1 ∪ s2 := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro xins
      simp [s] at xins
      simp [s1, s2, M1, M2]
      tauto
    · intro xins1s2
      simp [s1, s2, M1, M2] at xins1s2
      simp [s]
      tauto
  have dm : density M = s.card := by simp [density, s]
  have dm1 : density M1 = #s1 := by simp [density_def, s1]
  have dm2 : density M2 = #s2 := by simp [density_def, s2]
  have s1eqs2card : (s1 ∪ s2).card = s1.card + s2.card := by
    apply card_union_of_disjoint
    rw [disjoint_left]
    aesop
  rw [← seqs1s2] at s1eqs2card
  aesop
end P2

section P3
open Finset Set

variable {α β : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [LinearOrder β]

@[nolint unusedArguments]
def AllPattern (m n : ℕ) : Fin m → Fin n → Prop := fun _ _ ↦ True
abbrev VerticalPattern (m : ℕ) : Fin m → Fin 1 → Prop := AllPattern m 1
abbrev HorizontalPattern (n : ℕ) : Fin 1 → Fin n → Prop := AllPattern 1 n

  ![
    ![False, True, False],
    ![True, False, True]

lemma ex_verticalPattern_two (n : ℕ) : ex (VerticalPattern 2) n = n := by
  classical
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · simp only [ex, Finset.sup_le_iff, mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    intro M
    contrapose
    simp only [density, not_le]
    intro more_than_n
    let f : Fin n × Fin n → ℕ := fun ⟨i, j⟩ ↦ j
    let s := (filter (fun (i, j) ↦ M i j) univ)
    have : s.card > n := by aesop
    let t : Finset ℕ := Finset.Iio n
    let k := 1
    have hf ⦃a⦄ (_ : a ∈ s) : f a ∈ t := by simp [f, t]
    have hn : t.card * k < s.card := by aesop
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := exists_lt_card_fiber_of_mul_lt_card_of_maps_to hf hn
    simp only [k] at hy'
    rw [one_lt_card] at hy'
    simp only [mem_filter, ne_eq] at hy'
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := hy'
    obtain ⟨ha, ha'⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨hb, hb'⟩ := hb
    rw [Contains]
    have : a.2 = b.2 := by
      simp only [f] at ha' hb'
      rw [← ha'] at hb'
      omega
    have dominance : a.1 < b.1 ∨ b.1 < a.1 := by grind
    let g := ![a.2]
    have gmono : StrictMono g := by simp [StrictMono]
    cases dominance with
    | inl ab =>
      refine ⟨![a.1, b.1], by  simpa [f, StrictMono, Fin.forall_fin_two], g, gmono, ?_⟩
      simp [Fin.forall_fin_two, AllPattern, g]
      aesop
    | inr ba =>
      let f := ![b.1, a.1]
      refine ⟨![b.1, a.1], by  simpa [f, StrictMono, Fin.forall_fin_two], g, gmono, ?_⟩
      simp [Fin.forall_fin_two, AllPattern, g]
      aesop
  · obtain rfl | hn := eq_zero_or_neZero n
    · simp
    refine (le_ex_iff _ ⟨0, by simp [AllPattern]⟩).2 ⟨fun i j ↦ i = 0, ?_, ge_of_eq ?_⟩
    · rintro ⟨f, hf, g, hg, prop⟩
      simp only [AllPattern, forall_const, Fin.forall_fin_two, Fin.isValue] at prop
      exact (hf Fin.zero_lt_one).ne <| prop.1.trans prop.2.symm
    · calc  density _
        _ = #{x : Fin n × Fin n | x.1 = 0} := density_def _
        _ = #({0} ×ˢ .univ : Finset <| Fin n × Fin n) := by congr; aesop
        _ = n := by simp

  classical
  simp only [ex, Finset.sup_le_iff, mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  intro M NoHPk
  refine density_by_rows_ub M fun i ↦ ?_
  contrapose! NoHPk
  simp [row_density] at NoHPk
  let s : Finset (Fin n) := {j | M i j}
  have h : k ≤ s.card := by simp [s]; omega
  let g := s.orderEmbOfCardLe h
  simp only [Contains, Fin.forall_fin_one, Fin.isValue]
  refine ⟨![i], by simp [StrictMono], g, by simp [StrictMono, OrderEmbedding.lt_iff_lt], ?_⟩
  simp only [Fin.isValue, AllPattern, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, forall_const]
  intro j
  simpa [s] using s.orderEmbOfCardLe_mem h j

name: ex_identityPattern_le
statement: theorem ex_identityPattern_le (k n : ℕ) : ex (IdentityPattern k) n ≤ (2 * n - 1) * (k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_zero_or_neZero n
  · simp [ex, density]
  classical
  simp only [ex, Finset.sup_le_iff, mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  intro M avoid_Ik
  by_contra! M_large_density
  let d : Fin n × Fin n → ℤ := fun ⟨i, j⟩ ↦ i - j
  let s : Finset (Fin n × Fin n) := {(i, j) : Fin n × Fin n | M i j}
  let t : Finset ℤ := Icc (-n + 1) (n - 1)
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hp'⟩ : ∃ p ∈ t, k - 1 < #{x ∈ s | d x = p} := by
    apply exists_lt_card_fiber_of_mul_lt_card_of_maps_to
    · simp [s, d, t]
      grind
    convert! M_large_density
    simp [t]
    lia
  let fiber : Finset (Fin n × Fin n) := {x ∈ s | d x = p}
  let fiberSnd : Finset (Fin n) := {x.2 | x ∈ fiber}
  have card_fiber : #fiber = #fiberSnd := by apply card_bij fun a _ ↦ a.2 <;> aesop
  have le_card_fiberSnd : k ≤ #fiberSnd := by simp [← card_fiber, fiber]; lia
  let g := fiberSnd.orderEmbOfCardLe le_card_fiberSnd
  let f (i : Fin k) : Fin n := (ZMod.finEquiv n).symm p + g i
  have f_spec a (a' : Fin n) (ha : a' - g a = p) : f a = a' := by simp [f, ← ha]
  have mono_f : StrictMono f := fun a b hab ↦ by
    have hga : g a ∈ fiberSnd := fiberSnd.orderEmbOfCardLe_mem _ a
    have hgb : g b ∈ fiberSnd := fiberSnd.orderEmbOfCardLe_mem _ b
    simp only [mem_filter, Prod.exists, exists_eq_right, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, fiberSnd, fiber,
      d] at hga hgb
    obtain ⟨a', -, ha'⟩ := hga
    obtain ⟨b', -, hb'⟩ := hgb
    have hgab : g a < g b := by simpa
    have hab' : a' < b' := by grind
    simpa [f_spec _ _ ha', f_spec _ _ hb'] using hab'
  refine avoid_Ik ⟨f, mono_f, g, by simp [StrictMono], ?_⟩
  simp only [IdentityPattern, forall_eq']
  intro a
  have hga : g a ∈ fiberSnd := fiberSnd.orderEmbOfCardLe_mem _ a
  simp only [mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Prod.exists, exists_eq_right, fiberSnd, fiber,
    d, s] at hga
  obtain ⟨a', hfa', ha'⟩ := hga
  simpa [f_spec _ _ ha'] using hfa'

name: av_perm_contract_av_perm
statement:
lemma av_perm_contract_av_perm (q : ℕ) (σ : Perm (Fin k)) (M : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    (hM : ¬ Contains (PermPattern σ) M) : ¬ Contains (PermPattern σ) (blkMatrix M q)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra H
  obtain ⟨f, hf, g, hg, h⟩ := H
  simp only [PermPattern, blkMatrix, rectPtsetq, rectPtset, Finset.mem_Ico, mem_product, mem_filter,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and, forall_eq'] at h
  choose fg hfg using h
  refine hM ⟨Prod.fst ∘ fg, ?_, Prod.snd ∘ fg ∘ ↑σ⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a b hab
    obtain ⟨A, ⟨B, ca_ub⟩, C, D⟩ := hfg a
    obtain ⟨E, ⟨cb_lb, F⟩, G, H⟩ := hfg b
    calc
      (fg a).1 < q * (f a + 1) := ca_ub
      _  ≤ q * f b := by gcongr; exact hf hab
      _  ≤ (fg b).1 := cb_lb
  · intro a b hab
    obtain ⟨A, B, C, ca_ub⟩ := hfg (σ⁻¹ a)
    obtain ⟨D, E, cb_lb, F⟩ := hfg (σ⁻¹ b)
    calc
      (fg <| σ⁻¹ a).2 < q * (g a + 1) := by simpa using ca_ub
      _  ≤ q * g b := by gcongr; exact hg hab
      _  ≤ (fg <| σ⁻¹ b).2 := by simpa using cb_lb
  · rintro i j rfl
    simpa using (hfg i).1
end P

name: le_ex_permPattern
statement: theorem le_ex_permPattern (σ : Perm (Fin k)) (n : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) : n ≤ ex (PermPattern σ) n
proof:
:= by
  have : k.AtLeastTwo := ⟨hk⟩
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := exists_pair_ne (Fin k)
  exact le_ex_self_of_two_points _ _ ⟨(a, σ a), (b, σ b), rfl, rfl, by aesop⟩

section Containment

variable {α β γ δ : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [LinearOrder β] [LinearOrder γ] [LinearOrder δ]
  {P : α → β → Prop} {M : γ → δ → Prop}

def Contains (P : α → β → Prop) (M : γ → δ → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : α → γ, StrictMono f ∧ ∃ g : β → δ, StrictMono g ∧ ∀ a b, P a b → M (f a) (g b)

lemma not_contains_false (P : α → β → Prop) (P_nonempty : ∃ a b, P a b) :
    ¬ Contains P fun (_ : γ) (_ : δ) ↦ False := by simp [Contains, *]

end Containment

section ExtremalFunction

open Finset

variable {α β γ δ : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [LinearOrder β] [LinearOrder γ] [LinearOrder δ] {m n : ℕ}
  {P : α → β → Prop}

open scoped Classical in
noncomputable def density (M : Fin m → Fin n → Prop) : ℕ := #{(i, j) : Fin m × Fin n | M i j}

lemma density_def {n : ℕ} (M : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) [DecidableRel M] :
    density M = #{(i, j) : Fin n × Fin n | M i j} := by unfold density; convert rfl

open scoped Classical in noncomputable
def ex (P : α → β → Prop) (n : ℕ) : ℕ := sup {M : Fin n → Fin n → Prop | ¬ Contains P M} density

@[simp] lemma ex_zero (P : α → β → Prop) : ex P 0 = 0 := by simp [ex, density]

theorem le_ex_iff (P : α → β → Prop) (P_nonempty : ∃ a b, P a b) {m n : ℕ} :
    m ≤ ex P n ↔ ∃ (M : Fin n → Fin n → Prop), ¬ Contains P M ∧ m ≤ density M := by
  obtain rfl | hm := eq_zero_or_pos m
  · simpa using ⟨_, not_contains_false P P_nonempty⟩
  · simp [ex, Finset.le_sup_iff hm]

theorem den_all1_matrix_single_row {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n) :
    let M (i _ : Fin n) : Prop := i = x
    density M = n := by
  classical
  intro M
  have : density M = #(({x} : Finset (Fin n)) ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))) := by
    simp only [density]
    congr 1
    ext ⟨a, b⟩
    simp [M, eq_comm]
  rw [this]; simp

theorem den_all1_matrix_single_col {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n) :
    let M (_ j : Fin n) : Prop := j = x
    density M = n := by
  classical
  intro M
  have : density M = #((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) ×ˢ ({x} : Finset (Fin n))) := by
    simp only [density]
    congr 1
    ext ⟨a, b⟩
    simp [M, eq_comm]
  rw [this]; simp

theorem le_ex_self_of_two_points (P : α → β → Prop) (n : ℕ)
    (hP : ∃ x y : (α × β), P x.1 x.2 ∧ P y.1 y.2 ∧ x ≠ y) : n ≤ ex P n := by
  obtain rfl | n_pos := eq_zero_or_neZero n
  · simp
  simp only [ne_eq, Prod.ext_iff, not_and_or] at hP
  obtain ⟨⟨a₁, b₁⟩, ⟨a₂, b₂⟩, h₁, h₂, ha | hb⟩ := hP
  · refine (le_ex_iff _ ⟨_, _, h₁⟩).2 ⟨fun i j ↦ i = 0, ?_, by simp [den_all1_matrix_single_row]⟩
    rintro ⟨f, hf, g, hg, hfg⟩
    exact ha <| hf.injective <| (hfg _ _ h₁).trans (hfg _ _ h₂).symm
  · refine (le_ex_iff _ ⟨_, _, h₁⟩).2 ⟨fun i j ↦ j = 0, ?_, by simp [den_all1_matrix_single_col]⟩
    rintro ⟨f, hf, g, hg, hfg⟩
    exact hb <| hg.injective <| (hfg _ _ h₁).trans (hfg _ _ h₂).symm

end ExtremalFunction

open Finset Set OrderDual Equiv

variable {k n q : ℕ}

def PermPattern (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (i j : Fin n) : Prop := σ i = j
